title: Stop paying for API tokens
description:
Stop paying for API tokens! GitHub just made GPT, Llama, DeepSeek, and Grok free for everyone — and most people have no idea. Before, if you wanted to build anything with AI — an app, an agent, an automation — you had to buy paid API tokens first, and they were expensive. Now you just head over to GitHub and open the model marketplace.
